member.name: P:Havit.Blazor.GoogleTagManager.HxGoogleTagManagerOptions.EnableInitialPageViewTracking
member.summary:
Whether is pushed for the page the document was loaded with.
Set to false when the GTM container already covers document loads with the pageview event or its built-in Page View trigger — otherwise the landing page of every session is counted twice. Explicit calls are not affected.
Default: true.

member.name: T:Havit.Blazor.GoogleTagManager.HxGoogleTagManagerPageViewTracker
member.summary: Initializes Google Tag Manager and tracks page-views to the GTM data-layer.
member.remarks:
Supports all render modes:
Static SSR and prerendering — the GTM snippet is rendered inline, so GTM starts loading while the page is still being parsed.
Static SSR with enhanced navigation — page-views are pushed by the Havit.Blazor.GoogleTagManager.lib.module.js JS initializer, which listens for enhancedload.
Interactive Server, WebAssembly and Auto — page-views are pushed in reaction to , which covers navigations resolved by the interactive router.
Initialization and automatic page-views are deduplicated in JavaScript, so rendering the component more than once (e.g. in App.razor for the earliest possible GTM load and in the layout to cover interactive routing) does not produce duplicate events.
Full documentation and demos: https://havit.blazor.eu/components/HxGoogleTagManager

member.name: M:Havit.Blazor.GoogleTagManager.HxGoogleTagManagerPageViewTracker.GetInitializationScript
member.summary: Repeats what HxGoogleTagManager.js initialize() does, because the snippet has to run while the HTML is being parsed, long before any ES module can be imported. Both share the same window.hxGoogleTagManager state, so whichever runs first is the one that initializes GTM.
